question: For each academic year, provide the academic year description, the average and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) of the total units for subjects offered by the Mathematics department in non-summer, non-current terms, and indicate whether the average total units for that year is 'HIGH_LOAD' (at least 10% greater than the overall average), 'LOW_LOAD' (at least 10% less than the overall average), or 'AVERAGE' otherwise. Do not return any rounded answers.

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    t.ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    t.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC,
    c.TOTAL_UNITS
  FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
  JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t
    ON c.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE
  WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'
    AND t.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N'
    AND t.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%'
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS overall_avg
  FROM base
),
yearly AS (
  SELECT
    ACADEMIC_YEAR,
    ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC,
    AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units,
    STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_units
  FROM base
  GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC
)
SELECT
  y.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC,
  y.avg_units,
  y.stddev_units,
  CASE
    WHEN y.avg_units >= o.overall_avg * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_LOAD'
    WHEN y.avg_units <= o.overall_avg * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_LOAD'
    ELSE 'AVERAGE'
  END AS load_category
FROM yearly y
CROSS JOIN overall o
ORDER BY y.ACADEMIC_YEAR

persistent_recovery_advisory_draft.base_sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cco.TOTAL_UNITS
  FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS at
  JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED cco ON at.TERM_CODE = cco.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE
  WHERE cco.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'
    AND at.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N'
    AND at.TERM_CODE NOT LIKE '%SU'
),
year_stats AS (
  SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC,
         AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units,
         STDDEV(TOTAL_UNITS) AS stddev_units
  FROM base
  GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC
),
overall AS (SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS overall_avg FROM base)
SELECT ys.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ys.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ys.avg_units, ys.stddev_units,
  CASE WHEN ys.avg_units >= oa.overall_avg * 1.10 THEN 'HIGH_LOAD'
       WHEN ys.avg_units <= oa.overall_avg * 0.90 THEN 'LOW_LOAD'
       ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS load_classification
FROM year_stats ys CROSS JOIN overall oa
ORDER BY ys.ACADEMIC_YEAR
